records.subject: spec-guard-release-artifact
evidence: result:the package was built from the v0.36.0 tag with git archive of .claude-plugin and plugins/spec-guard plus ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json, the method that rebuilt v0.24.0 file-for-file identical to its published asset
result:release-package.py validated the artifact directory before archiving and again after extracting the archive; the archive contains no AppleDouble entries
result:the locally built archive and the downloaded published GitHub asset both have SHA-256 7299f1afe090e9030087ab990fb4d97b0e054ac84ed4e13e409a7c7e32c7f65c, matching the digest GitHub reports
content:module_stage.py in the package defines unmerged_commits for the DONE/MODULE_DONE hint, and local_ledger_runtime.py defines state_worktree_status for the ledger conflict report
result:the required GitHub Actions checks validate (ubuntu-latest) and validate (macos-latest) passed on 38f7a08, the release pull request head whose tree is identical to the tagged merge commit
